_comment: Short forms that mean a different work, or no work, far more often than the one the table registers. Keys are normalized surfaces (lowercase, no periods). Each rule applies only when the resolved work is `work`. `context` is a regex that must match the sentence before this one, or the text of this sentence before the citation (author context); without a match the citation is dropped. `veto_before` is a regex tested against the text immediately before the citation; a match drops it (another author or a commentary title stands there). `redirect` re-points the citation to another work when its regex matches the context. `veto_before_all` applies to every explicit abbreviation.
